<parameter=code>

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('b', 'Y', 'p'):
        boundary = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        print(f"  color={n['color']} pixels={n['pixels']} bbox=({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)})")

# Check bottom row
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print(f"Bottom row: {ascii_lines[63][:10]}...")

# Diff with previous
prev_ascii = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')
curr_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\n=== DIFF ===")
for r in range(len(curr_ascii)):
    if prev_ascii[r] != curr_ascii[r]:
        changes = []
        for c in range(min(len(prev_ascii[r]), len(curr_ascii[r]))):
            if prev_ascii[r][c] != curr_ascii[r][c]:
                changes.append(f"col {c}: {prev_ascii[r][c]}->{curr_ascii[r][c]}")
        if changes:
            print(f"Row {r}: {changes}")

</function>
